anya: quick flag 04 on /docs/quickstart/install/ for the es locale. image `static/images/es/install-step-2.png` 404s on staging.

lee: thanks. is the file missing or path mismatch?

anya: path mismatch. the markdown points to `/static/images/es/install-step-2.png` but in repo it lives at `static/assets/install/es-step2.png`. looks like an earlier refactor renamed assets but not the markdown.

sam: i think i touched that area last sprint. i moved many locale assets into `/static/assets` to reduce copies. didn't update the MD refs everywhere. my mistake.

lee: can you open a tiny PR to either restore the image at the old path or update markdown links? prefer updating links to `/static/assets/...` and add a follow-up to adjust the asset index.

sam: will do. plan: update the markdown to reference `/static/assets/install/es-step2.png`, add a quick grep test in docs CI that looks for `/static/images/` references and warns. snippet for CI: ```bash
# scripts/check_image_refs.sh
set -e
missing=0
for ref in $(grep -oP "\(/static/images/[^)]+\)" -R docs || true); do
  img=$(echo $ref | tr -d '()')
  if [ ! -f "$img" ]; then
    echo "MISSING: $img"
    missing=1
  fi
done
[ $missing -eq 0 ] || exit 2
```

anya: nice. also add a short line in the PR body explaining why `/static/assets` is preferred to avoid future drift.
